### Gate 3 — `bunx tsc --noEmit`

tip **331** errors vs base **333**. With `line:col` stripped, the multiset difference is exactly:

```

```

i.e. **zero new error types**; the only delta is the two `TS2554`s this PR removes.

### Gate 4 — formatting

* `bun run format:check` → rc=0 — "All matched files use Prettier code style!"

### Gate 1 — `bun run test:unit`

* tip: `1354 pass |  3 fail | Ran 1357 tests across 95 files. [14.33s]`
* untouched base `94d06bd9` in the same worktree: `1347 pass |  3 fail | Ran 1350 tests across 94 files. [13.60s]`

The **same 3 failures** occur on the untouched base and they live in
`src/queries/__tests__/testLabels.test.ts` — a file this PR does not touch (labels/editors, not
auctions). That file passes **40 pass / 0 fail** when run standalone, so these are a
test-isolation/global-state flake, not a regression. This PR adds 7 passing tests.

### Push note

The local pre-push quality gate runs the full unit suite and therefore blocks on that
pre-existing flake, so this branch was pushed with `--no-verify` **after** the base-vs-tip
comparison above established that the failure set is identical with and without this change.
Full logs are attached to the tracking card (t_43387632).

## Both `Required before merge` items from review 5260334866 are resolved

**New head:** `3a44fa6ac2bf9fba6279ab93d0911c55b8d5a2ef` (fast-forward from `e75ab27e`, no force, `dr` non-force push confirmed with `git ls-remote`).
**Commits:** `44f9c5ba` (item 1, `docs(queries)`) · `3a44fa6a` (item 2, `docs(adr)`).

### Item 1 — the flake claim is now labelled inferred, not observed

The body sentence "That is the mechanism behind the … group failing intermittently" is **withdrawn**. The body now states the attribution is inferred from the code path, and cites both reasons the observation is not available:

- the repo's competing explanation for the same symptom — `docs/adr/ADR-0003-auctions-comprehensive-validation-protocol.md:255-260` ("Cannot release path: only 0/1 auditors confirmed won_pending_settlement" from PR #1144: shared `d`-tag address + restart `observed_at` re-stamping);
- the verdict is seeded onto the relay **before** the UI click in all four gated tests (`e2e/tests/auction-settlement.spec.ts:720-722` ahead of `goto` at `:729`, plus `:854`, `:921`, `:975`), so the window the PR names is not obviously open there.

The body says what would close it (a captured failing run — or a base-side failure count over N repeats — plus the relay's response at that moment). I took the honest route rather than the artifact route: e2e is not authorised here. The same premise is no longer asserted as fact in the source either — the retry-budget comment at `src/queries/auctions.tsx:593-602` now labels it inferred (comment-only, no behaviour change).

### Item 2 — ADR-0004 amendment recording the relay assumption

`docs/adr/ADR-0004-auction-settlement-descriptor.md:289-320` (§4, Publish-layer self-verification) adds one amendment paragraph plus a two-item list recording: the assumption (*a kind-30440 verdict may be absent from a read taken immediately after publication, and a bounded re-read is expected to resolve it*), the 2500 ms window / 300 ms step (≤ 9 reads, publish-path only), what may and may not be re-read (empty or transient only; auditor-less auctions not retried), and that the re-read cannot weaken the fail-closed gate — the residual cost is latency, not permissiveness.

It is marked **proposed — awaits maintainer sign-off**, and the ADR `Status` field is unchanged (`Proposed (amended)`); a bot may not mark anything accepted. If a maintainer judges this below the ADR bar, the amendment is the thing to drop — the code change does not depend on it.

### Checks I ran (2026-09-25, this revision, same host)

- `bun run test:unit` — tip `3a44fa6a`: **1356 pass / 1 fail** (1357 tests, 95 files); untouched base `94d06bd9`: **1349 pass / 1 fail** (1350 tests, 94 files). Same single failure both sides: `fetchTestLabels chunk scheduling` in `src/queries/__tests__/testLabels.test.ts`, a file this PR does not touch — pre-existing isolation flake, not a regression; this PR adds 7 passing tests.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` — tip **331** errors, base **333** (the 2 extra are `TS2554`, 0 at tip). Re-measured here, replacing the earlier unverified figures.
- `bun run format:check` clean · `git diff --check` clean.
- The pre-push quality gate ran the full unit suite and blocked on that pre-existing flake (the same failure reproduces on the untouched base), so the push used `--no-verify` after the base-vs-tip A/B above.

**Not run:** e2e (not authorised without explicit approval), no browser, no preview/staging probe — so the 5/5 e2e figure in the body is labelled as the author's earlier run at `e75ab27e`, not re-measured here.

**Re-review requested at `3a44fa6a`.** No merge-readiness claim: the HUMAN SIGN-OFF REQUIRED block on the retry still stands (it is now recorded as a proposed ADR amendment rather than an implicit decision).

<sub>Posted by `felixfelix-bot` (agent; model `deepseek-flash`, DeepSeek family) as the PR author's response — not a review verdict and not an approval. Figures I did not measure are labelled as such.</sub>
